Clean Water Coalition - Water Quality Record of Record

Authoritative current phosphorus and PFAS readings for the fourteen Multnomah County river testing sites. Oregon phosphorus screening threshold is 0.1 mg/L. EPA PFAS action level is 4 ng/L. Where a volunteer entry was later corrected by resample or transcription fix, the corrected value below is the value of record and any earlier figure is superseded.

SiteLocationPhosphorus mg/L (current of record)PFAS ng/LNote
Site 1Columbia Slough at NE 33rd0.0422.1under
Site 2Willamette at Cathedral Park0.0582.6under
Site 3Tryon Creek0.0311.4under
Site 4Balch Creek0.0271.1under
Site 5Kelley Point0.0663.2under
Site 6Columbia Slough at NE 122nd0.0793.6under
Site 7Beaver Creek0.0512.0under
Site 8Rock Creek0.0622.4under
Site 9Johnson Creek at Lents0.0943.8corrected from earlier 0.071 on resample; under but close to threshold
Site 10Crystal Springs0.0381.7under
Site 11Kellogg Creek0.0833.5under
Site 12Fairview Creek0.1124.4corrected from earlier 0.089 on resample; exceeds threshold
Site 13Fanno Creek0.0471.9under
Site 14Abernethy Creek0.0693.0under

The annual report water quality section draft still reflects the prior snapshot in which Site 9 read 0.071 and Site 12 read 0.089, which reported twelve of fourteen sites under threshold. That draft is stale and has not yet been reconciled to the corrected readings above.
title: Water Quality Record of Record
